name: keep mine > 1 MiB: staged transfer (mirror-side)
about: The restored text is empty and ced's copy is 1.4 MiB: delete the (empty) span is skipped, then consecutive <= 1 MiB inserts chained by expect_rev, each its own undo group, op_ids c<run>-keep<k>-<i>. Server-side steps depend on E1d's chunking, so E1d writes them when it implements the transfer; Stage S freezes the scenario and the expectations.
